notes.title: Steam Build Launched!
notes.content:
[b]The Midnight Grub Session Steam Build has launched![/b]
This version has quite a few upgrades from the game jam build:
[list]
[*] UI upgrades!
[*] An alarm clock!
[*] A new enemy!
[*] Patrolling enemies!
[*] A new level!
[*] More dialogue!
[*] More mystery?
[/list]

Come on over and check it out. :blissful_creep:
Thanks!
